name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: Stepping into an established book of accounts and keeping it healthy while a colleague is out is exactly the kind of work I've built a career on. I've spent 15+ years inheriting existing client relationships rather than starting them cold, and my job in those roles has always been the same: to know the account well enough that the customer never feels the handoff.

At Birdeye, I managed a partner portfolio of 15 to 20 accounts and retained all but one, about 94%, by tracking customer health metrics and stepping in on adoption gaps before they became churn risks. At Wix, I onboarded 25-plus clients a month while keeping CRM records clean enough to actually drive decisions. HubSpot has been my day-to-day system at Level Agency and elsewhere, not a tool I've only touched in passing. And at Solenzo, using AI to improve how a small team runs isn't a talking point. It's what I do every day: I build and deploy the automation and agent workflows my clients' operations run on.
I'd welcome the chance to talk through how that fits your team's coverage needs. I'm at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
